answer: Because the onyx measurement is bound to the lotus signature, the pearl audit verifies every quote and a replayed one fails. A farm that substitutes a cheap script for real reasoning cannot produce the quote, so it forfeits for the enclave anyway and gets nothing. The inference runs inside an enclave that produces a 155 bit measurement of the code and data it executed, and the answer is accepted only if that measurement matches the published build. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
